Title: Public Sign-Up Endpoint Fallback Accepts role=ADMIN
RootCauseSummary: Next.js API route had insecure in-memory fallback allowing role spoofing. Removed fallback; enforced HTTP 403 on port 3000 and port 8000.

Title: Potential Open Redirect via ?next= Parameter
RootCauseSummary: Unsanitized window redirect allowed protocol-relative URLs. Enforced sanitizeNextRedirect relative-path validator.

Title: Duplicate <h1> Headings on Main Landing Page
RootCauseSummary: Secondary heading rendered as H1. Changed to semantically correct H2.

Title: Emerald Brand Green Text Fails WCAG Contrast on Light Glass
RootCauseSummary: Used #52b788 on light backgrounds (2.8:1). Centralized to #087a3c (5.25:1 contrast).

Title: Social Media Links in Team Carousel Fail Minimum Touch Target
RootCauseSummary: Links had 24x24px bounds. Upgraded to min-w-[44px] min-h-[44px].

Title: Missing OWASP Security Headers and X-Powered-By Disclosure
RootCauseSummary: Missing middleware headers. Added X-Frame-Options DENY nosniff and removed X-Powered-By.

Title: Driver Dashboard Navigation Wraps on Mobile (360-390px)
RootCauseSummary: Fixed flex layout caused horizontal scroll. Added responsive wrapping and scroll-safe padding.

Title: Nav Item Live statistics Has Static Hardcoded Active Border
RootCauseSummary: Active state was hard-coded. Replaced with dynamic IntersectionObserver scroll-spy.

Title: Missing Edge Sliding-Window Rate Limiter on Sign-In Endpoint
RootCauseSummary: Caddy proxy bypassed in-memory rate limiting. Enforced PostgreSQL persistent rate limiter in FastAPI.

Title: Missing ISO 8601 Timezone Offsets in Driver Logistics Mock Data
RootCauseSummary: Timestamp lacked explicit timezone offset. Standardized to ISO 8601 UTC with +05:00 offset.

Title: Insecure JWT in localStorage Migrated to HttpOnly Cookies
RootCauseSummary: JWT in localStorage vulnerable to XSS. Migrated to HttpOnly Secure SameSite=Lax cookies with double-submit CSRF.

Title: Backend Rate Limiting & Hashed SMS OTP with 60s Cooldown
RootCauseSummary: Plain OTP in memory without cooldown. Added SHA-256 hashed storage and 60s timer in database.

Title: Alembic Migration 0002 Empty downgrade() Reversible DDL
RootCauseSummary: Migration 0002 had pass in downgrade(). Implemented complete reverse DDL with automated cycle test.
